items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clark Terry and I have known . . . He’s been on “Piano Jazz” of course. We’ve known each other for a million years.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. So you feel that that program, so it has say from 1977, what was the base listeners? Was it just the jazz fans at that point? Once again, that climate was still more of a, fusion was sort of the height of its reign at that time, disco . . .

No, I think at that time there were just less of them, because the show had not gained such popularity. Now it’s on 260 stations, where at the time we might have been on 50 stations. Then there was a hiatus where I think we didn’t do anything for a year. I never found out ’til later that Dick Phipps got . . . went into a snit of some kind and got mad at me for something. So there was a hiatus where we didn’t record for a little while. Then we started up again, and then we started to really dig in and get grants…
